class.name: StreamingPipeline
class.brief_description: Coordinates streaming of visible splat data to the GPU.
class.description: Captures visible splat ranges on a CPU worker and publishes the latest snapshot through a [GaussianMemoryStream]. Initialize both resources on the RenderingDevice owner thread. Drain uploads there each frame with [method process_uploads] or [method get_current_buffer], and shut down there. The worker never calls GPU APIs.

method.name: get_current_buffer
method.description: Drains the latest pending snapshot on the initialization thread before returning the current buffer. Returns an invalid RID on upload failure.

method.name: process_uploads
method.description: Uploads the latest completed CPU snapshot. Call only on the initialization thread; a different thread returns ERR_UNAVAILABLE without consuming the snapshot. Upload failures are returned and recorded as [code]last_upload_error[/code] in streaming statistics. Pending snapshots count as [code]is_streaming[/code] until drained.
